decisions.title: Tormentón sorprende a Puerto Vallarta en este miércoles, Día de San Juan
decisions.note: Storm flooding affected El Pitillal and La Bobadilla; residents also reported trash and a persistently troubled arroyo.

decisions.title: SEAPAL Vallarta promete normalizar suministro de agua tras fallas eléctricas; “Llevamos desde el sábado sin agua”, responden ciudadanos
decisions.note: Residents reported ongoing water outages in Villa de Guadalupe and Coapinole despite SEAPAL's restoration promise.

decisions.title: SEAPAL Vallarta confirma canal obstruido tras inundación en la avenida Francisco Villa
decisions.note: A blocked storm-drain outlet caused flooding on avenida Francisco Villa and obstructed normal drainage.

decisions.title: Camión de carga pesada choca contra poste en la Zona Romántica y deja sin luz a varias colonias
decisions.note: A truck damaged electrical infrastructure on calle Púlpito, leaving the Zona Romántica area without power.

decisions.title: La crisis del agua en Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: The article documents a substantial citywide water crisis, but its political-opinion framing makes complaint qualification uncertain.

decisions.title: Mi compromiso es con Bahía de Banderas: Héctor Santana
decisions.note: An official inauguration reports a completed street rehabilitation in Bucerías, not a complaint; the municipality is also outside Puerto Vallarta.

decisions.title: SEAPAL saneó más de 32 millones de m³ de agua en 2025
decisions.note: An official SEAPAL performance report describes treatment and reuse results without a service complaint.

decisions.title: De jueves a viernes 32 colonias más se quedan sin agua al norte de Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: A failed pump leaves 32 northern Puerto Vallarta colonies without water while SEAPAL estimates restoration.

decisions.title: Campestre Las Cañadas se quedará sin agua este lunes 27 de abril en Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: An official notice schedules a one-day water cut in Campestre Las Cañadas for line interconnection work.

decisions.title: Arranca ampliación de la carretera Mezcales–San Vicente a ocho carriles
decisions.note: The road-expansion project is in Bahía de Banderas, outside Puerto Vallarta.

decisions.title: Explota camión recolector de basura en Vallarta por tanque de helio y batería; Aseo Público lanza importante llamado
decisions.note: A garbage-truck safety incident prompts disposal advice; it does not describe a resident service complaint.

decisions.title: Lluvias aumentan hasta 25% fugas y rupturas en red de agua potable
decisions.note: The article describes increased water leaks, pipe ruptures, and sewage blockage risks affecting Puerto Vallarta services.

decisions.title: Obra de la CFE deja sin agua a seis colonias de Puerto Vallarta; SEAPAL trabaja para restablecer el servicio
decisions.note: CFE contractor damage to a water pipe leaves six Puerto Vallarta colonies awaiting gradual service recovery.

decisions.title: Inundaciones menores, arboles caídos y cocodrilo en Las Mojoneras por lluvia matutina
decisions.note: A weather incident report describes minor flooding and trees down, without a resident infrastructure complaint or significant effects.

decisions.title: Avenida Francisco Villa amanece bajo el agua en Puerto Vallarta; inundación deja autos varados tras la lluvia
decisions.note: Flooding on avenida Francisco Villa stranded vehicles and disrupted residents’ travel after heavy rain.

decisions.title: Centenar de sindicalizados regresaron a recolección de basura en Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: An official union account describes garbage-service staffing and normalization rather than a resident complaint.

decisions.title: ¿No tienes agua? SEAPAL activa pipas gratuitas en estas colonias de Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: SEAPAL supplies emergency tankers because many Puerto Vallarta areas remain without stable water service.

decisions.title: Puerto Vallarta comienza restablecimiento de agua; se completará en 72 horas
decisions.note: SEAPAL reports gradual recovery after a mega-cut, while many colonies still await stable water pressure.

decisions.title: Desesperados por falta de agua, vallartenses aprovechan la lluvia y ojos de agua para bañarse
decisions.note: Residents remain without water nearly a week into the contingency and resort to rain, streams, and an area spring.

decisions.title: Munguía prometió devolver el agua a Vallarta; el desabasto sigue generando hartazgo
decisions.note: A political accountability article reports a real prolonged water shortage, but its commentary framing makes qualification uncertain.
